evidence: Main page exposes official Search by Industry Classification taxonomy hierarchy.
Official search URL accepts a classification label and returns multiple matching listed companies in one result set.
Observed official example: /listedCompaniesPage/search?language=pt-br&segment=QWdyaWN1bHR1cmE%3D returns 9 companies for Agricultura in one request.
This is a bounded classification-group query, not per-security web fanout.
Official Up2Data Listed Companies channel has FinancialData, OutstandingShares, PositionOfShareholders, SummaryData; SummaryData is described as company summary registration.
Official page links a Listed_Companies.zip sample and UP2DATA data dictionary.
The sample archive and XLSX dictionary links were identified but their binary contents were not machine-readable through the bounded retrieval path used in this stage.
No official text retrieved in this stage explicitly proves that SummaryData carries B3 Classificacao Setorial fields; therefore this route is not used to pass Classification Content.

technical_assets.access_finding: Direct access requires Master UP2DATA contract; Listed Companies has a specific monthly access tariff; UP2DATA Client/Cloud use contracted access and access keys. Distribution/publication is separately governed and subject to B3 approval.

page_backed_example.classification_membership_semantics: All returned companies are members of the requested official B3 industry-classification label.

basis: The public official classification hierarchy and page-backed search use classification names/labels.
No stable B3 source-native sector/subsector/segment classification code was exposed by the resolved public classification route.
The official classification criteria and bounded technical evidence retrieved for this stage do not establish such a code.
The UP2DATA Listed Companies binary sample/data dictionary could not be inspected through the bounded retrieval channel, and no official text retrieved proves a classification code there.
Local hashing, ordinal numbering, normalized labels, or invented codes are prohibited and were not created.

Official page-backed classification query returned 9 listed companies in one result set for Agricultura; result fields include legal name, trading name, governance segment and B3 company code.

Official UP2DATA data dictionary XLSX link resolved; binary content was not retrievable through the bounded web text channel, so no classification field/code was inferred.
Official policy confirms contracted UP2DATA Client/Cloud access, access keys, Listed Companies pricing, Master contract requirement and separate distribution/publication governance.
